owis.marathiMeaning: जें खरें नाही तें खरेंपणानें मानलें तर तर मग असे ठरविणर्‍या जाणत्यांची गरजच नाही. परंतु अविद्या आली कीं तिच्या प्रभावानें असें प्रकार घडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If the unreal is imagined to be real then, how can you be a wise examiner? Due to the power of *avidya/ ignorance, that essence (I do not exist) has become like avi- dya/ignorance only. *(avidya maya- to take yourself to be a body; vidya maya- to take yourself to be knowledge)

owis.original: मनुष्यांची बाजीगरी । बहुत जनास वाटे खरी । सेवट पाहातां निर्धारीं । मिथ्या होये ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जादुगारानें निर्माण केलेल्या सर्व वस्तु खर्‍या वाटतात. पण जादुचा खेळ संपल्यावर पाहिलें तर त्या खोट्या होत्या हें निश्र्चयानें कळते.
owis.englishMeaning: The magic of man (imagination, rajo guna ie. avidya) has caused this `all' world to appear as a gross objective world and the people feel that it is true. In the end however, one understands that these were both false appearances within that supportless Reality (both vidya and avidya are maya).

owis.original: तैसीच माव राक्षेसांची । देवांसहि वाटे साची । पंचवटिकेसि मृगाची । पाठी घेतली रामें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राक्षससुद्धा अशीच माया रचतात व ती देवांनासुद्धा खरी वाटते. पंचवटीमध्यें असतांना श्रीरामाने भुलुन खोत्या सुवर्णमृगाचा पाठलाग केला.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this also is the deceit of this demon called ignorance. Due to it, the true God feels that this world is true. Even ram had wanted the skin of the deer made of the five elements. (When ram forgot Himself, He became ravana. Such is the power of ignorance. Then he wanted the skin/support of an `animal that sees a mirage' ie. jiva and having been deceived by ignorance, He took Himself as a body made up of the five elements. You are ram and you have forgotten Yourself, due to ignorance)

owis.original: पूर्व काया पालटिती । येकाचेचि बहुत होती । रक्तबिंदीच जन्मती । रजनीचर ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राक्षस मायेने आपलें शरीर बदलतात. एकाचे पुष्कळ होतात. युद्धामध्यें रक्ताच्या एका थेंबांतून पुन्हा जन्म घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This demon moves around in the night of ignorance when it turns away from its previous body (ie. supra-causal or light of knowledge). Out of that One (atma) this `all' has come and then this `all' takes a birth from out of a few drops of *blood (due to gross body identification). *(maharaj semen is the essence of blood)

owis.original: नाना पदार्थ फळेंचि जाले । द्वारकेमधें प्रवेशले । कृष्णें दैत्य किती वधिले । कपटरुपी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक वस्तु व फळें यांची रुपें घेऊन राक्षस द्वारकेंत शिरले. पण कृष्णाने अशा कित्येक कपटी राक्षसांना ठार मारलें.
owis.englishMeaning: According to legend, the devils entered into the city of *dwarka appearing as `many' fruits and objects.And it is said that krishna killed these devils who had taken `many' forms made of deceit and ignorance (due to ignorance, `many' names and therefore `many' forms have appeared upon this `I am'; only krishna knew how to kill them). *(dwarka was krishna's city; this `I am')

owis.original: कैसे कपट रावणाचें । सिर केलें मावेचे । काळनेमीच्या आश्रमाचें । अपूर्व कैसें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रावणाने कपटीपणाने रामाचे खोटे शिर सीतेला दाखविले. तर काळनेमीनें ऋषीचे रुप घेऊन व आश्रम निर्माण करुन मारुतीला फसविले.
owis.englishMeaning: How great was the deceit of ravana, he even made an enchanting head of *ram. He even made an place of rest/ashram for the demon kalanema.14 But how could this be that `which has never been seen before' (ie. atma). *(maharaj: ram and ravana are yourself only)

owis.original: नाना दैत्य कपटमती । जे देवांसहि नाटोपती । मग निर्माण होऊन शक्ती । संव्हार केला ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कपटबुद्धि असलेले पुष्कळ राक्षस देवांनाही आटोपत नसत. मगभगवंताच्या शक्तीनें अवतार घेऊन त्यांचा संहार केला.
owis.englishMeaning: These devils of the `many' are so cunning and skilled in magic (ie. this is a man, this is a woman and this is a cup etc. etc.) but God created this shakti and destroyed them (`I am' or shakti has power over all objects and it destroys avidya and objectification). Still understand this shakti has no control over God (ie. shiva, the Knower of this `I am'). (maharaj- a thought is just like a mosquito: one slap and it is dead)

owis.original: ऐसी राक्षेसांची माव । जाणों न सकती देव । कपटविद्येचें लाघव । अघटितज्यांचें ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी ही राक्षसांची माया देवांनासुद्धा कळत नसे. राक्षसांचे कपटविद्येंतील प्राविण्य कल्पनेपलीकडील होते.
owis.englishMeaning: It is not possible for God to know the deceit of this demon called ignorance (ie. for He knows only His shakti/knowledge). Its skill in the art of deception has been acquired from this wonder of mula maya (from the original illusion ie. mula maya/shakti there manifests the gunas and from tamo guna there comes the five elements and from the five elements there comes `many' objects; see 8.4).

owis.original: मनुष्यांची बाजीगरी । राक्षसांची वोडंबरी । भगवंताची नाना परी । विचित्र माया ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणुस जें खोटे निर्माण करतो त्यास जादुगीरी, राक्षस जें खोटे निर्माण करतात त्यला वोडंबरी किंवा इंद्रजाल म्हणतात. तर भगवंतापासून जें खोटे निर्माण होतेत्यास माया म्हणतात. ही माया विचित्र आहे. ती अनेक प्रकार निर्माण करते.
owis.englishMeaning: Man performs the worthless trickery of imagination ("There is this and that"); the demon performs an empty show of magic and makes you forget yourself (only you are there, but this you have forgotten ie. ignorance). But these `many' variegated forms are the maya of God and she has no power over God.

owis.original: हे साचासारिखीच दिसे । विचारितांच नसे । मिथ्याची आभासे । निरंतर पाहातां ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही माया अगदी खर्‍याप्रमाणें दिसते. विचार केला तर नाहीशी होते. सारखी दिसत असल्यानें खोटी असूनही खर्‍याप्रमाणें भासते.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self is seen it appears as the `all' and is felt to be true (because its base is true). But when thoughtlessness is understood then, this world of the `all' is known to be untrue. That `one beyond the inner space'/parabrahman understands that it is false even though it appears (ie. then it is just like a dream).

owis.original: साच म्हणावी तरी हे नासे । मिथ्या म्हणावी तरी हे दिसे । दोहीं पदार्थीं अविश्र्वासे। सांगतां मन ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरी मानावी तरी ही नाश पावते. खोटी म्हणावी तर प्रत्यक्ष दिसते. म्हणून मन ती खरी म्हटली तरी विश्र्वास ठेवत नाही व खोटी म्हटली तरी विश्र्वास ठेवत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: If it is said to be true, still it is destroyed and if it is said to be false, still it is seen. And if such a mind has no faith in that purush then, it will create many objects within this prakruti/purush. (Mind cannot understand that Reality, it sees only Reality's reflection ie. knowledge (purush/prakruti). But it has no faith in this either and it then creates many names and forms thinking it will gain happiness there)

owis.original: परंतु हे नव्हे साचार । मायेचा मिथ्या विचार । दिसतें हें स्वप्नाकार । जाण बापा ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परंतु हें कांहीं खरें नाहीं मायेचा विचार म्हणजे खोट्याचा विचार आहे. हें सगळें दृश्य केवळ स्वप्नासारखें आहे. हें समजुन राहा.
owis.englishMeaning: But then that thoughtless Truth is not and there are the illusory thoughts of maya. Then that thoughtless Self becomes a `dweller in a dream' who sees many forms. Know this my dear man.

owis.original: तथापी असो तुजला । भासचि सत्य वाटला । तरी येथें चुका पडिला । ऐक बापा ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा दृश्य पसारा खरा नाहीं. तो भास आहे. असे समजावून सांगितलें तरी तुला तो भासच खरा वाटतो. असे कां होते तें तुला सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If still you feel that this appearance is true, then that brahman `there' is committing a terrible mistake. Therefore listen, my dear man (for this is the only sadhana).

owis.original: दृश्यभास अविद्यात्मक । तुझाहि देहो तदात्मक । म्हणौनि हा अविवेक । तेथें संचारला ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्याचा पसारा अविद्येने भरलेला आहे. तसाच आपला देहसुद्धां अविद्येंतच जन्मतो. त्यामुळें खोटे असणारे दृश्य खरें आहे. असा अविवेक आपल्यांत संचरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This visible appearance is full of ignorance/avidya (gross objectivity) and your body is also of the nature of ignorance/avidya and so that thoughtless understanding `there' has been completely covered over by non-discrimination/avivek.

owis.original: दृष्टीनें दृश्य देखिलें । मन भासावरी बैसलें । तरी तें लिंगदेह जालें । अविद्यात्मक ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण डोळ्यांनी जी वस्तु पाहातो आपले मन त्या वस्तुचे रुप घेते. सूक्ष्म देहांत प्रतिमा तयार होते. अविद्येनें निर्माण केलेल्या वस्तुला धारण करणारा सूक्ष्म देहसुद्धा अविद्यामयच असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The seer perceives this visible `all' but, when the mind dwells upon this appearance and takes pleasure in this then, that Reality appears as a *subtle body that is full of avidya (ie. gross objectivity). *(ie. made up of mind, buddhi, chitta, ego, prana, ten senses etc.)

owis.original: अविद्येनें अविद्या देखिली । म्हणोनि गोष्टि विश्र्वासली । तुझी काया अवघी संचली । अविद्येची ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाहणारा दृष्टा अविद्यामय व पाहिलेलें दृश्यसुद्धा अविद्यामय असते. म्हणून द्रष्ट्याचा दृश्याच्या खरेपणावर विश्र्वास बसतो. आपला संपूर्ण देह आंतून बाहेरुन अविद्येने भरलेला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is avidya being seen by avidya and this `I am' believes that this is real and then your gross body and `many' things of avidya are created. (maharaj- when knowledge is happy just to know itself then that is vidya maya....when it becomes a little more objective then the elements appear ..... that is avidya maya)

owis.original: तेचि काया मी आपण । हें देहबुद्धीचें लक्षण । येणें करितां जालें प्रमाण । दृश्य आवघें ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो देहच मी आहे असे समजणें हें देहबुद्धीचें लक्षण होय. या दृढ भावनेनें दृश्य बघितले म्हणजे तें खरें वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that Reality says, "I am a body" and that attentionless, thoughtless Self acquires an attention that brings body consciousness. And on account of this, that nirgun Knower appears as the many visible objects.

owis.original: इकडे सत्य मानिला देहो । तिकडे दृश्य सत्य हा निर्वाहो । दोहींमधें माहां संदेहो । पैसावला बळें ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह खरा मानला. दृश्य खरें मानलें. यामुळें दोन्हीमध्यें वेगळेपणा निर्माण होऊन दृश्याबद्दल द्रष्ट्याच्या मनांत संशय जबरदस्तीने पसरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Whether there is a gross body of only this much or there is this visible `all', still both are regarded as the Truth because their base is the Truth (even if the gross body is left aside on account of its falsity, still that Truth gets superimposed upon this `all' body). Originally in prakruti/purush, there had been this great doubt of `I am' and this had then expanded into the `many' doubts that come with the thought, "I am a body".

owis.original: देहबुद्धि केली बळकट । आणी ब्रह्म पाहों गेला धीट । तों दृश्यानें रुधिली वाट । परब्रह्माची ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपली देहबुद्धी न सोडता आणखी बळकट करुन परब्रह्म पाहाण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तर असे आढळतें कीं परब्रह्माची वाट दृश्यानें अडविली आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: If you hold fast to the notion that you are this `all' body and audaciously try to see brahman then, due to this visible `all' the path of parabrahman is obstructed.

owis.original: तेथें साच मानी दृश्याला । निश्र्चयचि बाणोनि गेला । पाहा हो केवढा चुका पडिला । अकस्मात ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण दृश्याला खरें मानून आत्मज्ञानाच्या क्षेत्रांत प्रवेश करण्याचा प्रयत्न करतो. हा केवढा घोटाळा झाला पाहा.
owis.englishMeaning: Actually it is that brahman who is regarding this visible `all' as the Truth and therefore, how then can the conviction of that One Reality be imbibed? Understand how great the error is that has been suddenly committed.16

owis.original: आतां असो हें बोलणें । ब्रह्म न पाविजे मीपणें । देहबुद्धीचीं लक्षणें । दृश्य भाविती ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहबुद्धीनेम, मीपणाने ब्रह्मप्राप्ती होईल हें शक्य नाही. परंतु हें बोलणें आतां पुरे. दृश्यावर खरेपणाचा विश्र्वास असणें हेंच देहबुद्धीचें लक्षण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: For now that thoughtless Self is this `I am' and brahman cannot be achieved by such `I'-ness. Still this attention that had been placed upon the gross body is now being placed upon this visible `all' (ie. `I'-ness needs a body, either the gross or this `all', but some body is required).

owis.original: अस्तिचा देहीं मांषाचा डोळा । पाहेन म्हणे ब्रह्माचा गोळा । तो ज्ञाता नव्हे आंधळा । केवळ मूर्ख ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला देह हाडांचा सापळा आहे. त्यामधें मांसाचा डोळा आहे. त्यानेम जो मी ब्रह्म पाहिन असें म्हणतो तो ज्ञानी नव्हे तर आंधळा व मूर्ख आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: If in a body of bones and eyes of flesh, you say, "I will understand the totality of brahman," then, really you are not a Knower and that pure knowledge has become a blind fool.

owis.original: दृष्टीसि दिसे मनासि भासे । तितुकें काळांतरी नासे । म्हणोनि दृश्यातीत असे । परब्रह्म तें ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृष्टीला जेम दिसते व मनास जें भावते ते सर्व कांहीं काळाने नष्ट होणारे आहे. म्हणून परब्रह्म हे दृष्यापलीकडील आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever is seen and whatever is perceived by mind, that much is destroyed at the end of `time'. Therefore understand; that which is beyond this visible `all' is pa- rabrahman.

owis.original: परब्रह्म तें शाश्वत । माया तेचि अशाश्वत । ऐसा बोलिला निश्र्चितार्थ । नाना शास्त्री ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्म हें शाश्वत आहे तर मायाही अशाश्वत आहे. असा निश्र्चित निर्णय नाना शास्त्रांनी सांगितला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That parabrahman is eternal and maya is when That appears as non-eternal. She is this steady `speech' within the `many' shasthras.

owis.original: आतां पुढें निरुपण । देहबुद्धीचें लक्षण । चुका पडिला तो मी कोण । बोलिलें असे ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां पुढिल समासांत देहबुद्धीच्या लश्रणांचे निरुपण आहे. ज्याच्याबद्दल भ्रम निर्माण होऊन घोटाळा निर्माण झाला. तो मी कोण हें सांगितलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, if ahead this sagun discourse becomes the attention of gross body consciousness then, that atma will ask "Who am I?" and this `speech' will surely be missed. (Body consciousness asks "Who am I?"; while that sagun discourse knows `I am')

owis.original: मी कोण हें जाणावें । मीपण त्यागूनि अनन्य व्हावें । मग समाधान तें स्वभावें । आंगीं बाणें ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मी कोण आहे हें जाणून घ्यावें. मगदेहाच्या मीपणाचा त्याग करुन खर्‍या मीशी एकरुप, अनन्य व्हावें. हें जर जमले तर समाधान लाभते.
owis.englishMeaning: "What is this I?" This you should known. Then by renouncing this `I'-ness there should be no-otherness and that samadhan that is within this bliss of the `all' body will be naturally imbibed. (Bliss is the pleasure that comes when this created `I am' is understood. samadhan is the natural uncreated pleasure of the One without a second) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Sar Shodhan (The Search for the Essence)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: गुप्त आहे उदंड धन । काये जाणती सेवक जन । तयांस आहे तें ज्ञान । बाह्याकाराचे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका श्रीमंताने पुष्कळ धन दडून ठेवलें. तें नोकरांना तें गुप्त धन माहिती नसते. घरांत, बाहेर दिसणारी संपत्तीच त्यांना माहित असते.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast wealth (ie. I do not exist) is hidden. How can those people in the service of that vast paramatma know It? (How can the mind know that One who made it?) They only have knowledge of that Reality's outer forms.

owis.original: गुप्त ठेविलें उदंड अर्थ । आणी प्रगट दिसती पदार्थ । शाहाणे शोधिती स्वार्थ । अंतरीं असे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळ धन लपविलेले व बाहेर दिसणार्‍या वस्तु फारच थोडया. तसेंच दृश्य मायेच्या आंत असलेला खरा मी शहाणे शोधत असतात. हाच खरा स्वार्थ समजावा.
owis.englishMeaning: That wealth of paramatma has been kept hidden and this manifest `all' is seen. The wise however, search within this `all' to find their own wealth (one's own true wealth is within this `I am' and beyond duality; it is that thoughtless paramatma).

owis.original: तैसें दृश्य हें माईक । पाहात असती सकळ लोक । परी जयांस ठाउका विवेक । ते तदंतर जाणती ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हें मायेने व्याप्त सर्व जग लोक पाहात असतात. पण शहाणे लोक विवेकाने दृश्याच्या आंतील तें आत्मस्वरुप समजतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this visible `all' then, that thoughtless Self appears to be false and, in the same way, when that thoughtless Self is understood then, this `all' world becomes false. But first there has to be vivek, for it is only when mula maya is known that there can be the understanding of that thoughtless Reality.

owis.original: द्रव्य ठेऊन जळ सोडिलें । लोक म्हणती सरोवर भरलें । तयाचें अभ्यांतर कळलें । समर्थ जनासी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका खड्यांत पाणी सोडले. लोकांना तें भरलेले तळें दिसते. पण जाणत्यांनाच त्या खड्याच्या तळाशी धन, द्रव्य ठेविलेले आहे तें समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if the `many' objects are maintained then, this pure water (ie. `I am'/knowledge) gets thrown away and the world says, "There is a *lake" (ie. due to ignorance, we form `many' names and concepts like lake, ocean, river, puddle etc., but all the names mean one thing only and that is water. Therefore we must learn to see with the eyes of knowledge). But when one understands that innermost Reality then, this world becomes that non-dual Self (when we use vivek then, the `many' concepts disappear and what remains is, what is). *(maharaj- the child says, "Look father, it is water", but the father says, "No, that is the ocean." The boy was right but they put more concepts in him)

owis.original: तैसे ज्ञाते ते समर्थ । तेहीं वोळखिला परमार्थ । इतर ते करिती स्वार्थ । दृश्य पदार्थाचा ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें ज्या पुरुषांजवळ ज्ञान असते, त्यांना परमार्थ ओळखता येतो. पण अज्ञानी मात्र दृश्य पदार्थ साठविण्यांत आपला स्वार्थ समजतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Because this known (ie. mula maya or knowledge) has come from that non-dual Self, this known can recognise *paramarth. Others remain selfish and they make that Reality appear as the `many' objects. *(To be that non-dual Self is the ultimate accomplishment or supreme wealth/paramarth)

owis.original: काबाडी वाहाती काबाड । श्रेष्ठ भोगिती रत्नें जाड । हें जयाचें तयास गोड । कर्मयोगें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ओझीं वाहणारे लोक ओझी वाहण्यांत जन्म घालवितात. तर श्रेष्ठ पुरुष मौल्यवान रत्नांचा उपभोग घेतात. कर्मयोगानें हें ज्याचें त्यास योग्य वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: They become labourers and pull around their heavy burdens (ie. their bodies) while that most excellent Self enjoys the real jewels (within the `many' thoughts there is this thought `I am' and that thoughtless, I do not exist, and it is the jewel in the crown of paramarth).17 Then that Reality enjoys the delights of mula maya and its associated karma (mula maya or `I am' is nothing but the results of past action. Whatever will happen has already been determined by these past actions ie. karma. Therefore your duty is to be that Reality and always remain aloft from that which is naturally appearing within you).

owis.original: येक काष्टस्वार्थ करिती । एक शुभा येकवाटिती । तैसे नव्हेत कीं नृपति । सारभोक्ते ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी पोटासाठी मोळ्या विकतो तर कोणी गोवर्‍या विकतो. पण राजे मात्र असे नसतात. ते वैभव भोगतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But if that One takes itself to be a body and collects firewood or makes cow-dung cakes then, He does not behave as the King should and does not enjoy that essence (ie. He is the Self and thoughtlessness is His wealth).

owis.original: जयांस आहे विचार । ते सुकासनीं जाले स्वार । इतर जवळील भार । वाहातचि मेले ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्यांच्याजवळ सारासार विचार असतो, ते स्वानंदाच्या सिंहासनावर स्वार होतात. ज्यांच्याजवळ हा विचार नसतो, ते दृश्य पदार्थांचे ओझे वाहण्यांतच जगतात व मरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When to this `I am' there comes the understanding, I do not exist, then, that One gets carried on the throne. The rest, they remain attached to their burdens and therefore have to carry them around with them until they die.

owis.original: येक दिव्यान्नें भक्षिती । येक विष्ठा सावडिती । आपण वर्तल्याचा घेती । साभिमान ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मज्ञानी पुरुष जणूं उत्तम अन्न सेवन करीत असतात. तर अज्ञानी मात्र जणूंकाहीं विष्ठाच चिवडतात. तें जें करतात त्याचाच अभिमान बाळगतात.
owis.englishMeaning: 17The jewel in the crown of practice is when the sagun thought ceases in the nirgun dasbodha. siddhar- meshwar maharaj- The greatest practice of all practices is when this `I am' thought ceases in that nirgun swarup. But for that to happen, the very last remnant of worldly life must be left. Without giving up your human-ness, one can never become God. The mind should be indelibly stamped with, `I am brahman. Even if two hundred thousand rupees are offered to me still, I will not hold the body conviction.' 9. That One (ie. brahman) tastes of this divine `food' (ie. when all the senses come together in the bliss of `I am') and the other one (jiva) collects only *excreta and takes pride in such behaviour. *(maharaj this body is nothing but a shit factory).

owis.original: सार सेविजे श्रेष्ठी । असार घेयिजे वृथापृष्टीं । साराअसाराची गोष्टी । सज्ञान जाणती ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें खरोखर श्रेष्ठ आहेत, त्यांनी सारच सेवन करीत असावें. आळशीं व ऐतखाऊं लोकांनीं असार सेवन करावें. सार व असार ह्याचे ज्ञान फक्त सज्ञानी लोकच जाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: First this `worthless mountain of flesh' should accept the non-essence (ie. `I am') and then that atma should taste that thoughtless essence. The one who knows pure knowledge has taken this `speech' and made it into that essence.

owis.original: गुप्त परीस चिंतामणी । प्रगट खडे कांचमणी । गुप्त हेमरत्नखाणी । प्रगट पाषाण मृत्तिका ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परिस व चिंतामणी ही मौल्यवान रत्नें गुप्त असतात. तर खडे व काचेचे मणी मात्र कोठेही पडलेले असतात. सोन्याच्या व रत्नांच्या खाणी गुप्त असतात. तर दगड व माती कोठेंही पडलेले असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The paris stone that turns iron to gold and the wish-stone/chintamani that takes away all worries are both hard to find, while ordinary stones and glass beads are plenty and readily available. The mines of gold and jewels are also hidden, yet dirt and rocks are seen everywhere.

owis.original: अव्हाशंख अव्हावेल । गुप्त वनस्पति अमोल । येरंड धोत्रे बहुसाल । प्रगट सिंपी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उजव्या बाजूला तोंड असलेला शंख किंवा उजव्या बाजूनें वाढणारा वेल किंवा दिव्य वनस्पति गुप्त असतात. तर एरंड, धोत्रा व शिंपला ही मात्र सगळीकडे असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The right turning conch and the right turning creeper and valuable herbs are hidden, but castor, thorn apple and shells are evident at `many' places.

owis.original: कोठे दिसेना कल्पतरु । उदंड सेरांचा विस्तारु । पाहातां नाहीं मळियागरु । बोरि बाभळा उदंडी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शेराची झाडे बरीच असतात. कल्पतरु मात्र कोठेंच आढळत नाही. चंदनाचे झाड शोधून सापडत नाही. बोरी-बाभळीची झाडे मात्र इकडेतिकडे सर्वत्र आढळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The wish-fulfilling tree (kalpataru ie. you are this knowledge and you become wha- tever you think) is not seen anywhere because that vast swarup has expanded into a profusion of milk-bush trees in this gross world. The rare *sandalwood tree cannot be seen anywhere because that vast swarup has become the trees of gum-arabic and bora (ie. the valuable cannot be seen due to objectification). *(It gets rubbed away in the performance of worship)

owis.original: कामधेनु जाणिजे इंद्रें । सृष्टींत उदंड खिल्लारें । महद्भाग्य भोगिजे नृपवरें । इतर कर्मानुसार ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत गाई पुष्कळ आहेत. कामधेनु मात्र इंद्रापाशींच आहे. एकटा राजा हार मोठें भाग्य भोगतो. इतर लोक मात्र आपापल्या कर्मानुसार भोगतात.
owis.englishMeaning: indra, the lord of the senses, knows this divine cow (ie. knowledge) but in the gross world, that vast paramatma has appeared as the `many' herds of cattle. The very fortunate enjoy the pleasures of the King/atma and others get according to their karma (it's all a matter of attention; if that Self holds on to body consciousness then, you have to endure the results of your past actions. If there is atma consciousness then, your attention is upon the understanding, `nothing is there'. And if there is that pure attention then, there is that attentionless swarup)

owis.original: नाना व्यापार करिती जन । आवघेचि म्हणती सकांचन । परंतु कुबेराचें महिमान । कोणासीचि न ये ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत नाना प्रकारचे व्यापार व्यापारी आहेत. ते सगळे धनिक म्हणविले जातात. मात्र कुबेरासारखा श्रीमंत कोणी कधीच होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' activities then, the people say, "We are so wealthy." But then how can they know the wealth of kuber (ie. treasurer of all the gods ie. gunas, elements, senses etc.)?

owis.original: तैसा ज्ञानी योगेश्र्वर । गुप्तार्थलाभाचा ईश्र्वर । इतर ते पोटाचे किंकर । नाना मतें धुंडिती ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो ज्ञानी आहे, योगेश्र्वर आहे. गुप्त असलेले परमात्मरुपी धन मिळवितो. बाकीचे सर्व पोटभरु केवळ मतमतांतरें शोधित बसतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The gnyani is the Lord of yoga and He is the Lord of that hidden wealth. But for the rest, that Reality has become a slave to the mind and it goes rummaging through the `many' opinions.

owis.original: तस्मात सार ते दिसेना । आणी असार तें दिसे जना सारासार विवंचना । साधु जाणती ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यामुळे सार किंवा गुप्त परमार्थ ज्ञान दिसत नाही. केवळ असारच, पोटभरु ज्ञानच लोकांना दिसते. सार व असार सार शोधून काढणें केवळ साधु जनांनाच माहित असते.
owis.englishMeaning: That essence cannot be seen and this non-essence (`I am') has appeared as the `many' people. Only the sadhu knows that investigation between the essence and non- essence (maharaj- most so-called Saints have gone up to knowledge only).

owis.original: इतरांस हें काये सांगणें । खरें खोटें कोण जाणे । साधुसंतांचि खुणे । साधुसंत जाणती ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सामान्य जनांना हें सांगुन उपयोग नाही. त्यांना खरेखोटे समजत नाही. साधुसंतच त्या खुणा जाणूं शकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: How can others understand thoughtlessness? How can they know what is true and what the false? Only the sadhu and Saint knows the understanding of the sadhu and Saint.

owis.original: दिसेना जें गुप्त धन । तयासि करणें लागे अंजन । गुप्त परमात्मा सज्जन- । संगतीं शोधावा ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गुप्त असलेले धन डोळ्यांत अंजन घातल्यावर दिसते. तसेच दृश्यामध्यें गुप्त असलेले परमार्थ ज्ञान ज्ञानी साधुसंतांच्या संगतींतच प्राप्त होते. म्हणुन सत्संगती धरावी.
owis.englishMeaning: mula maya cannot see that hidden wealth. And even to see this action of the `all', a special lotion/anjana (ie. knowledge) has to be applied to the eyes before one can see with the eyes of knowledge. Therefore in the company of the sajjana, that hidden paramatma, beyond knowledge, should be searched out. (maharaj- anjana means knowledge; niranjana means beyond knowledge)

owis.original: रायाचे सन्निध होतां । सहजचि लाभे श्रीमंतता । तैसा हा सत्संग धरितां । सद्वस्तु लाभे ॥ २०॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राजाच्या नजिकतेमुळे सामान्याला श्रीमंती, मान मिळतो. तसाच सत्संग धरिला तर सद्वस्तुचा- आत्मस्वरुप ज्ञानाचा लाभ होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as one naturally becomes rich in the company of a king, so too, when you hold firmly to the company of that thoughtless Saint or Truth, then that Absolute Self is attained.

owis.original: सद्वस्तुस लाभे सद्वस्तु । अव्यावेस्तासअव्यावेस्तु । पाहातां प्रशस्तास प्रशस्तु । विचाार लाभे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला परमात्मवस्तुची तळमळ लागते त्याला ती मिळते. ज्याचें जीवन अव्यवस्थित त्याच्या जीवनांत गोंधळच असतो. थोर लोकांचा सहवास असेल तर मोठ्या विचारांचा लाभ होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The true Self will gain the true Self and the confused will gain the confused only. Therefore be that most excellent and gain that most excellent thoughtless Self (siddha- rameshwar maharaj- worship God by being God).

owis.original: म्हणौनि हें दृश्यजात । आवघेंचि आहे अशाश्र्वत । परमात्मा अच्युत अनंत । तो या दृश्यावेगळा ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणुन हें दृश्य विश्र्व विनाशी आहे. अच्चुत व अनंत परमात्मा याहून वेगळा आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if that thoughtless Self should gain this created `all' still, just like this world of many forms, it is not eternal. That paramatma is changeless and endless and different from this visible `all'.

owis.original: दृश्यावेगळा दृश्याअंतरी । सर्वात्मा तो सचराचरीं । विचार पाहातां अंतरीं । निश्र्चये बाणे ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो परमात्मा दृश्याहून वेगळा असला तरी तो दृश्यामधेंच आहे. सर्व चराचरांत तो भरलेला आहे. सूक्ष्म विचार केल्यावर तो सर्वांच्या अंतर्यामी आहे असे निश्र्चयात्मकज्ञान होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Separate from and within this inner space of the visible `all' there is that atma of the `all' (purush or Knower). He is within this whole animate and inanimate creation and when there is that thoughtless understanding then, your conviction will abide within but beyond this inner space (ie. understand, I cannot be anything I see or perceive).

owis.original: संसारत्याग न करितां । प्रपंचउपाधी न सांडितां । जनामध्यें सार्थकता । विचारेंचि होये ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संसार व प्रपंचाच्या खटपटी न सोडतां केवळ विचारांच्या सामर्थ्यानें संसारांत राहूनच जन्माचे सार्थक करणारें आत्मज्ञान होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Without renouncing samsar or leaving your home and without having to continually let drop the limiting concepts of prapanch, the purpose of life within this world is fulfilled, only by understanding, I do not exist (by not taking the touch of the mind).

owis.original: हें प्रचितीचें बोलणें । विवेकें प्रचित पाहाणें । प्रचित पाहे तें शाहाणे । अन्यथा नव्हे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माझा स्वतःचा असा अनुभव मी तुम्हाला सांगितला. असा अनुभव घेऊन बघणारा शहाणा होय. अनुभव न घेणारा शहाणा नव्हे.
owis.englishMeaning: First that thoughtless Self should be this `I am' experience and this is understood through vivek. When this experience is understood then, that should be regarded as wisdom, otherwise not.

owis.original: सप्रचित आणी अनुमान । उधार आणी रोकडें धन । मानसपूजा प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन । यांस महदांतर ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उधारी व रोकडा पैसा; मानसपूजा व प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन यांत जसा मोठा फरक आहे, तसाच फरक कल्पना व अनुभव यांत फरक आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this pure `I am' experience and there is conjecture; there is credit and there is this wealth, directly gained (ie. there is the promise of something to be gained in the future or there is the understanding `I am', the very moment you drop these thoughts). There is the surrender of the mind (ie. I do not exist) and there is the seeing through the senses and these two are very different from this `I am' experience (this `I am' is the bridge between "I am a body" and I do not exist).

owis.original: पुढें जन्मांतरीं होणार । हा तों अवघाच उधार । तैसा नव्हे सारासार । तत्काळ लाभे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुढें होणार्‍या जन्मांत ईश्र्वर दर्शन होणारच आहे. हा उधारीचा व्यवहार. पण सारासार विचारानें याच जन्मांत आत्मज्ञान प्राप्त होते.
owis.englishMeaning: If it is said, "Later, at the end of this life you will gain it," then that thought- less understanding has become yet another empty promise in this worldly existence. Thoughtlessness is not like this; for it is gained at this very moment.

owis.original: तत्काळचि लाभ होतो । प्राणी संसारीं सुटतो । संशय अवघाचि तुटतो । जन्ममरणाचा ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सारासार विवेकानें आत्मज्ञान तत्काळ लाभते. संसारबंधनांतून व जन्ममरणाच्या फेर्‍यांतून मुक्तता होते. सर्व संशय मिटतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That benefit is gained at this very moment and then, that one in samsar within the prana, is set free. Then the doubts of this world and birth and death and this doubt of `I am' are severed.

owis.original: याचि जन्में येणेंचि काळें । संसारीं होईजे निराळे । मोक्ष पाविजे निश्र्चळें । स्वरुपाकारें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याच जन्मांत व याच कालांत मनानें समसारांतून मोकळे व्हावे. स्वस्वरुपाशी एकरुप होऊन निश्र्चळ होऊन मोक्ष मिळवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' has taken a birth and due to this, it will have to die. Therefore that one in samsar should be freed from this `I am' and that still `Dweller in the swarup' should gain its liberation (you are that Dweller in the swarup the very moment you realize you are; maharaj- understanding is realizing).

owis.original: ये गोष्टीस करी अनुमान । तो सिद्धचि पावेल पतन । मिथ्या वदे त्यास आण । उपासनेची ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मी जें आतां सांगितलें त्यांत जो कोणी संशय घेईल तो सिद्ध असला तरी त्यापासून भ्रष्ट होईल. जो कोणी हें खोटे म्हणेल त्याला माझ्या उपासनेची शपथ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When conjecture comes to this `speech' then, that perfect siddha becomes a fallen jiva. Then he proudly declares that this `vow of worship' (ie. `He does everything') is false and says "I am the doer."

owis.original: हें येथार्थचि आहे बोलणें । विवेकें सीघ्रचि मुक्त होणें । असोनी कांहींच नसणें । जनामधें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सारासार विवेकानें लचकर मुक्तहोतां येते हें माझें बोलणें अगदी बरोबर आहे. लोकांमधें राहून त्यांच्यांत नसल्याप्रमाणें वृत्ती ठेवता येते.
owis.englishMeaning: But in truth, this `speech' is that thoughtless Self appearing and by such vivek, one is immediately set free. Being and yet not even being this `all' within this world of `many' people (ie. the eternal Self that dwells within this knowledge that dwells within the body).

owis.original: देवपद आहे निर्गुण । देवपदीं अनन्यपण । हाचि अर्थ पाहातां पूर्ण । समाधान बाणे ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरा देव म्हणजे परमात्मस्वरुप निर्गुण आहे. त्या स्वरुपाशी एकरुप होणे आवश्यक आहे. ह्या अर्थांत समजुत पटली कीं, समाधान अंगी बाणते.
owis.englishMeaning: That state of God is nirgun. And in that state of God there is no-otherness. And when only that thoughtless wealth is understood then, complete samadhan is accepted.

owis.original: देहींचाविदेह होणें । करुन कांहींच न करणें । जीवन्मुक्तांचीं लक्षणें । जीवन्मुक्त जाणे ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहांत राहून देह नसल्यासारखीं वृत्ती ठेवणें आणि पुष्कळ कर्में करुन कांहींच न केल्यासारखें वर्तन असणें हीं जीवनमुक्ताची लक्षणें जीवनमुक्तच जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Being in the body (deha), one is beyond the body (videha). He is not this action of the `all' even. The jivan-mukta knows due to this attention of the jivan-mukta (jivan- mukti is liberation from this gross body concept; then your attention is upon this `all' world and only `I am' remains and you have become knowledge. And videha-mukti is liberation from this `all' body and then, even knowing does not remain and there is that attentionless Self).

owis.original: येरवीं हें खरें न वटे । अनुमानेंचि संदेह वाटे । संदेहाचें मूळ तुटे । सद्गुरुवचनें ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एरव्हीं हें खरें वाटत नाही. केवळ ानुभव नाहीं त्यामुळें कल्पनेबद्दल संशय वाटतो. पण हा संशय सद्गुरुवचनांवर विश्र्वास ठेवल्यास मूळापासून नष्ट होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In the jivan-mukta, that thoughtless Truth has not appeared and by conjecture the jivan-mukta descends into `many' doubts and assumes body consciousness. But due to this divine `word' of sadguru, the root of doubt is pulled out and thrown away (the jivan-mukta has to maintain this `speech' and then only can you become a videha mukta). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Anurvachya Nirupan (A Discourse on the Indescribable)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: समाधान पुसतां कांहीं । म्हणती बोलिजे ऐसें नाहीं । तरी तें कैसें आहे सर्वहि । निरोपावें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समाधान कसें असतें, हें शब्दानें सांगता येण्यासारखें नाही. तरी समाधान आहे तरी कसे तें सगळे मला सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "It is said that, when *samadhan wipes out this `all' then you should not `speak' (such samadhan is beyond this sagun `speech'; it is no-knowledge). Nevertheless, when there is that Reality, can there also be this `all' or knowledge? This should be discoursed to me" (maharaj- the Saint uses knowledge...otherwise how could He speak). *(The indescribable contentment of being One without a second)

owis.original: मुक्यानें गुळ खादला । गोडी न ये सांगाव्याला । याचा अभिप्राव मजला । निरोपण कीजे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या मुक्यानें गुळ खाल्ला तर त्याची गोडी त्याला सांगता येणार नाही. तसेंच समाधानाचें आहे. तर त्या म्हणण्याचा खरा अर्थ मला समजावून सांगा.
owis.englishMeaning: "It is said to be like a mute person eating jaggery, and the sweetness of that cannot be told (ie. pure direct experience is quite different from indirect experience). The meaning of this should be discoursed to me."

owis.original: अनुभवहि पुसों जातां । म्हणती न ये किं सांगतां । कोणापासीं पुसों आतां । समाधान ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याला तुझा अनुभव काय आहे असे विचारले तर तो सांगतो की, समाधान हें शब्दानें सांगता येण्यासारखें नाही. मग आतां मी समाधान कसें असतें हे कोणाला विचारु?
owis.englishMeaning: "It is said that, when this `I am' experience (indirect) gets wiped out then, that samadhan (direct Self experience, I do not exist) cannot be expressed. For when this `I am' gets wiped out then, who is there to experience that samadhan? This should be discoursed to me."

owis.original: जे ते अगम्य सांगती । न ये माझिये प्रचिती । विचार बैसे माझे चित्तीं । ऐसें करावें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो तो सांगतो की, समाधान जाणण्यास अशक्य आहे. पण मला हे पटत नाही. म्हणून स्वामी, माझ्या मनांत बसेल अशारीतीनें समाधानाचे स्वरुप मला सांगा.
owis.englishMeaning: "It is said that, when this `I am' (of mula maya) is that unfathomable thoughtlessness then, it cannot appear within my experience. Therefore that thoughtless understanding should be completely established in my mind."

owis.original: ऐसें श्रोत्याचें उत्तर । याचें कैसें प्रत्योत्तर । निरोपिजेल तत्पर । होऊन ऐका ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्याचा प्रश्र्ण हा असा आहे. त्याचे उत्तर आतां मी सांगतो तें मनापासून ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: When the listener is understanding this `I am' then, what is the need to ask any of these questions? Listen and be completely absorbed in its discourse. (But alas, no...)

owis.original: जें समाधानाचें स्थळ । किं तो अनुभवचि केवळ । तें स्वरुप प्रांजळ । बोलोन दाऊं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: केवळ अनुभव शुद्ध जाणीव हीच समाधानाची जागा आहे. त्या शुद्ध अनुभवाचे स्वरुप स्पष्ट करुन सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: "So is this `I am'/mula maya the place of samadhan and is this experience that pure knowledge?" The speaker replied, that swarup will only be revealed if you maintain this `speech' (all this can be answered only if the sadhak stops asking questions and stays in this `I am').

owis.original: जें बोलास आकळेना । बोलिल्याविणहि कळेना । जयासी कल्पितां कल्पना । हिंपुटी होये ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समाधान शब्दाने सांगावें म्हटलें तर शब्दबद्ध करता येत नाही. पण सांगितल्याशिवाय समजतही नाही. त्याची कल्पना करावी असे ठरविलें तरी कल्पनाशक्ती कमी पडते.
owis.englishMeaning: Still this `speech' cannot grasp that swarup and yet without this `speech', that swarup cannot be understood. And if this `speech' of mula maya should start imagining then, that imagination will only bring the miseries of bondage ("I am so and so" and so many questions).

owis.original: तें जाणावें परब्रह्म । जें वेदांचें गुह्य परम । धरिता संतसमागम । सर्वहि कळे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें समाधान परब्रह्मरुप आहे. तें वेदांचे परम रहस्य आहे. संतांच्या संगतींत राहीलें म्हणजे तें सर्व कांही समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: This mula maya should know that parabrahman; for this mula maya of the vedas is that hidden Supreme Self. And if you hold firmly to the company of the Saint/Truth, then this `I am' will understand that Reality (as the name suggests, mula maya is not true. It is an illusion, the original illusion and it means that, anything seen or perceived is merely an appearance or dream within that One indivisible Self).

owis.original: तेंचि आतां सांगिजेल । जें समाधान सखोल । ऐक अनुभवाचे बोल । अनुर्वाच्य वस्तु ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अत्यंत सूक्ष्म असलेलें असें जे समाधान तेच आतां वर्णन करुन सांगतो. माझ्या अनुभवाचे शब्द तूं ऐक. ऐरव्ही समाधान शब्दांनी सांगण्यासारखीं वस्तु नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: That Reality has become this `I am' experience and now with this understanding, thoughtlessness should be made and then this mula maya will be that most unfatho- mable samadhan. Therefore just listen to this `speech' of `I am' and then be that *inexpressible Self. (*maharaj where speech comes back, is my place)

owis.original: सांगतां न ये तें सांगणें । गोडी कळाया गूळ देणें । ऐसें हें सद्गुरुविणें । होणार नाहीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या गोडी कशी असते. हे कळण्यासाठीं गुळ द्यावा. त्याचप्रमाणें  सद्गुरुंनी दिल्यावाचून समाधान काय असतें हे बरोबर कळणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: You do not have to say anything to understand that Reality (ie. say nothing because I don't exist. This is the greatest worship). But just as as the sweetness of jaggery can only be understood by the taking of jaggery, so too, only by direct experience can this be understood `there'. However this thoughtlessness cannot be understood, without sadguru (maharaj- you cannot kill yourself; for that the sadguru is required).

owis.original: सद्गुरुकृपा कळे त्यासीं । जो शोधील आपणासी । पुढें कळे अनुभवासी । आपेंआप वस्तु ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो स्वतःचा शोध घेतो त्या सद्गुरुकृपा समजते. पुढें मग आत्मवस्तु स्वानुभवानें आपोआप कळूं लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: By the grace of sadguru, that atma purush is understood if mula maya goes on searching its own self. Then ahead, the understanding of that natural thoughtless Self will come to this experience.18

owis.original: दृढ करुनियां बुद्धी । आधी घ्यावी आपशुद्धी । तेणें लागे समाधी । अकस्मात ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बुद्धीचा पक्का निश्र्चय करावा. मग प्रथम मी कोण याचा शोध घ्यावा. तो शोध घेता घेता अकस्मात समाधी लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: An intellect/buddhi steadfast in this `I am' should be accepted at the beginning and in this way, you will be purified. Due to this, there will *unexpectedly be the establishment of samadhi.19 *(When you stop looking for it then, it will be there; for it is always there)

owis.original: आपलें मूळ बरें शोधितां । आपली तो माईक वार्ता । पुढें वस्तुच तत्वता । समाधान ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपलें मूळ स्वरुप नीट प्रकारें शोधू लागलें तर देहबुद्धींतील मी मायानिर्मित आहे असे समजते. देहबुद्धीचा अशाश्वत मी बाजूस ठेवला की, शुद्ध आत्मवस्तु शिल्लक राहाते व तेच समाधानाचे ठिकाण होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When you search out your own beginning then, `you' become an illusory rumour and there is only That. When ahead there is only that Self then, there is complete contentment/samadhan.

owis.original: आत्मा आहे सर्वसाक्षी । हें बोलिजे पूर्वपक्षीं । जो कोणी सिद्धांत लक्षी । तोचि सिद्ध ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मी ब्रह्म आहे. मी सर्व साक्षी आत्मा आहे. ही अवस्था अखेरची स्थिती नव्हे. जो कोणी या अवस्थेच्या पलीकडे जातो. तो खरा सिद्ध होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma is the *witness of this `all' then, there is this `speech' and this is the original hypothesis (`I am He'). But when that purush within this `all' beholds the siddhant (I do not exist) then He is a siddha. *(Witnessing implies duality as there must be the witnessed ie. the purush is there but remains hidden behind His prakruti. He illuminates her and He is knowing her but only she appears and is known)

owis.original: सिद्धांतवस्तु लक्षूं जातां । सर्वसाक्षी तो अवस्ता । आत्मा तीहून पर्ता । अवस्तातीत ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शेवटच्या अनुभवाच्या दृष्टीनें पाहिलें तर " मी सर्व साक्षी आहे " ही अवस्था आहे. या अवस्थेच्या पलीकडे असणारे आत्मस्वरुप सर्वसाक्षीपणाच्या पलीकडे राहाते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if you try to behold that siddhant then, that Reality becomes this state of witnessing the `all'. That atma is beyond her, for it is beyond any state.

owis.original: पदार्थज्ञान जेव्हां सरे । द्रष्टा द्रष्टेपणें नुरे । ते समंई उतरे । फुंज मीपणाचा ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञेयरुप पदार्थाचें ज्ञान जेव्हां निःशेष संपते. द्रष्ट्याचा द्रष्टेपणा संपूर्ण नाहींसा होतो, त्यावेळी मीपणाचा भ्रम संपूर्णपणें विरुन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the knowledge of this `all' ends, then the seer and the seeing are destroyed. Then, at that time, that Reality sets aside this swelling of I-ness.

owis.original: जेथें मुरालें मीपण । तेंचि अनुभवाची खूण । अनुर्वाच्य समाधान । या कारणें बोलिजे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मीपणा संपूर्णपणें विरणें हीच परमात्मवस्तुच्या अनुभवाची खूण आहे. म्हणून समाधान शब्दांनी सांगता येण्यासारखें नाही, असे म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When `here' I-ness is dissolved, there comes the nirgun understanding of that sagun experience. And on account of this `speech', there is that inexpressible samadhan.

owis.original: अत्यंत विचाराचे बोल । तरी ते माईक फोल । शब्द सबाह्य सखोल । अर्थचि अवघा ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अतिशय विचारांनी भरलेले शब्द जरी बोलले तरी ते दृश्य विश्र्वांतील मायेच्या क्षेत्रांतील असतात. मात्र त्यांचा जो अर्थ असतो तो सूक्ष्म असतो. त्या शब्दांना आत-बाहेर व्यापून असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: No matter how profound this `speech' of that thoughtless Self may be, still it is illusory and empty. And though this `word' is inside and outside of everything, still only its meaning has true substance.

owis.original: शब्दाकरितां कळे अर्थ । अर्थ पाहातां शब्द वेर्थ । शब्द सांगे ते येथार्थ । परी आपण मिथ्या ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्दामुळें अर्थ कळतो. अर्थ ध्यानांत आल्यावर शब्दाची गरज संपते. अर्थ सत्य व शाश्वत असतो. पण शब्द मात्र असत्य व अशाश्वत असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this `word', the meaning is understood but when the meaning is understood then, this `word' becomes useless. That Reality is the meaning of this `word' but the `word' itself is false.

owis.original: शब्दाकरितां वस्तु भासे । वस्तु पाहातां शब्द नासे । शब्द फोल अर्थ असे । घनवटपणें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्दामुळें परमात्मवस्तुच्या अस्तित्वाचे ज्ञान होते. परंतु त्या वस्तुचें साक्षात् दर्शन झाल्यावर शब्द नाश पावतो. शब्द असार कवच असून त्याचा अर्थ भरीव सार असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The `word' is that Self appearing and when that Self is understood then, this `word' is forgotten. For then this `word' is understood to be false and its meaning fills everywhere completely.20 20 nisargadatta maharaj- I am the manifestation. I, the Absolute unmanifested, am the same `I' manifested. Consciousness is the expression of the Absolute, there are not two.

owis.original: भुंसाकरितां धान्य निपजे । धान्ये घेऊन भूंस टाकिजे । तैसें शब्द भूंस जाणिजे । अर्थ धान्य ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भुसामध्येंच धान्य निपजते. आपण धान्य घेऊन भुसा टाकून देतो. तसेच शब्द म्हणजे भुसा व अर्थ म्हणजे धान्य समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of the husk the grain appears and then, the husk is thrown away and the grain accepted. Similarly, this `word' should be known as the husk and its meaning as the grain.

owis.original: पोचटामधें घनवट । घनवटीं उडे पोचट । तैसा शब्द हा फलगट । परब्रह्मीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पोकळ कवचामध्यें भरीव सार सांपडते. सार घेतल्यावर असार कवच उडून जाते. त्याचप्रमाणें परब्रह्मरुपी अर्थ घेतल्यावर फोलपट शब्द गळून पडतात. म्हणून आत्मसाक्षात्कारापाशीं शब्द जाऊं शकत नाहीत. त्याचे वर्णन होऊं शकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as the flimsy husk is filled with a complete grain and in that completely full grain, the flimsy husk flies away, so too, when within parabrahman this `word' flies away then, that thoughtless understanding remains.

owis.original: शब्द बोलोनि राहे । अर्थ शब्दापूर्वींच आहे । या कारणें न साहे । उपमा तया अर्थासी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उच्चार करण्याच्या आधीं अर्थ असतो. उच्चार होत असतांनाही अर्थ असतो व उच्चार होऊन शब्द नाहींसा झाला तरीही अर्थ असतो. त्यामुळें खरतर भुसा व धान्याची उपमा अर्थाला लागू पडत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: As long as you continue to `speak', then the `word' will remain. But the meaning is always there, even before the `word'. Still on account of the `word', the meaning becomes apparent, yet the meaning can never be compared to the `word'.

owis.original: भूंस सांडून कण घ्यावा । तैसा वाच्यांश त्यजावा । कण लक्ष्यांश लक्षावा । शुद्ध स्वानुभवें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भूस टाकून त्यांतील धान्याचा कण घेतात तसेच शब्दाचा वाच्यांश टाकावा व त्यांतील अर्थ तेवढा घ्यावा. शुद्ध आत्मसाक्षात्कारानें तो संपूर्णपणें ग्रहण होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as the husk should be left aside and the grain accepted, so too, the `word' meaning should be abandoned and the grain, that is the implied meaning, should be discerned by the pure experience of one's own Self.

owis.original: दृश्यावेगळें बोलिजे । त्यासी वाच्यांश म्हणिजे । त्याचा अर्थ तो जाणिजे । शुद्ध लक्ष्यांश ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " आत्मवस्तु दृश्याहून वेगळी आहे. " हा वाच्यांश होय. त्या अर्थ जो लक्ष्यांश तो समजून घ्यावा व त्याचे स्वानुभवामध्यें रुपांतर करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this separate visible `I am' is `spoken' then, that is called the `word' meaning and when that atma knows the meaning of that atma then, this is the pure implied meaning (then you finally meet your own Self).

owis.original: ऐसा जो शुद्ध लक्ष्यांश । तोचि जाणावा पूर्वपक्ष । स्वानुभव तो अलक्ष । लक्षिला नवचे ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्द ऐकल्यावर अर्थमय शुद्ध बोध किंवा लक्ष्यांश मनांत निर्माण होतो. पण तोही आत्मवस्तुच्या अलीकडेच थांबतो. आपले मन स्वस्वरुपाच्या अनुभवापर्यंत जाऊं शकत नाही. यामुळें सर्व अर्थ घ्यानांत येऊनही आत्मवस्तुचा अनुभव येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is that purush, He is the pure implied meaning, but first He should under- stand the hypothesis (`I am brahman'/`Thou art That'/tattwasmi). For Self-experience is inconceivable or beyond perception and therefore by concentration you cannot go there.

owis.original: जेथें गाळून सांडिलें नभा । जो अनुभवाचा गाभा । ऐसा तोहि उभा । कल्पित गेला ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मस्वरुप फार सूक्ष्म आहे. आपल्या अनुभवामध्यें आकाश अति सूक्ष्म आहे. तें गाळून घेतले तर त्याला आत्मस्वरुपाच्या सूक्ष्मपणाची सर येईल. असे तें स्वरुप सर्व अनुभवाचा गाभा आहे. त्याच्या सत्तेनें सर्व अनुभव येतात. पण हें सगळें स्वरुप वर्णन म्हणजे माणसानें आपली कल्पना ताणून उभारलेला डोलाराच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: `Here' (in mula maya) the sky is to be spread out and then let slip aside (first understand that everything you see and perceive is nothing ie. just like the sky. And then understand that this experience is also not true. The Truth will not be realized as long as you remain). That purush is the core of this experience and when He stops imagining this experience then, He will meet Himself.

owis.original: मिथ्या कल्पनेपासूनि जाला । खरेंपण कैंचें असेल त्याला । म्हणौनि तेथें अनुभवाला । ठावचि नाहीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुळांत कल्पना खरी नसते. म्हणून कल्पनेमुळें जे तयार होते, तेही खरे नसते. त्यामुळें आत्मस्वरुपाच्या ठिकाणी ज्याला अनुभव म्हणतात त्याला स्थान नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Because this `I am' experience has appeared from the false concept, "I am a body" then, how can there be any Truth to it? (the false will only make the false, it cannot make the Truth) Therefore, `there' (in brahman) is not the place of this experience.

owis.original: दुजेविण अनुभव । हें बोलणेंचि तों वाव । याकारणें नाहीं ठाव । अनुभवासी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनुभव येण्यास अनुभव घेणारा व ज्याचा अनुभव घ्यावयाचा  तें असें दोन घटक आवश्यक असतात. पण आत्मस्वरुपामध्यें अनुभव घेणाराच उरत नाही. तेथें दोन घटकच नसतात. त्यामुळें " मी स्वरुपाचा अनुभव घेतो " या अवस्थेला स्वस्वरुपसाक्षात्कारांत जागाच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: How can there be an experience without another (experience requires duality)? When there is experience then that thoughtlessness is this `speech' and this, we have proved, is empty like the husk. Nevertheless, understand that on account of this expe- rience there is no place for experience (experience goes off and becomes that One who had the experience).

owis.original: अनुभवें त्रिपुटी उपजे । अद्वैतीं द्वैतचि लाजे । म्हणौनि बोलणें साजे । अनुर्वाच्य ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी अनुभव घेतला " असें म्हटलें कीं, अनुभव घेणारा मी; ज्याचा अनुभव घेतला ती वस्तु, आणि या दोहोंचा संबंध आल्यावर आलेला अनुभव अशी तीन अंगें उत्पन्न होतात. त्यांना त्रिपुटी म्हणतात. स्वस्वरुपाच्या ठिकाणीं केवळ अद्वैतच असल्यानें भाषा पोहोचूं शकत नाही. म्हणून स्वस्वरुप अनुर्वाच्य आहे. शब्दानें तें सांगता येत नाही. हे त्याबद्दल योग्य आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this experience, the triad of Knower, knowing and known is created. Whereas in non-duality, duality is ashamed to enter. Still due to the company of this `speech', that inexpressible Self is achieved.

owis.original: दिवसरजनीचें परमित्य । करावया मूळ आदित्य । तो आदित्य गेलियां उर्वरित । त्यासी काये म्हणावें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्यामुळें आपण दिवस व रात्र वेगळें समजू शकतो. पण सूर्यच नाहींसा झाला तर दिवस व रात्र हा भेद राहणारच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The separateness of day and night is there only because of the sun. If the sun had not been there then, what should one call that which remains? (ie. it would be beyond compare, inexpressible)

owis.original: शब्दमौन्याचा विचार । व्हावया मूळ वोंकार । तो वोंकार गेलियाउच्चार । कैसा करावा ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व शब्दांचे मूळ ओंकार आहे. शब्द बोलणें किंवा मौन धरणें म्हणजे शब्द न बोलणें हे ओंकाराच्या अस्तित्वावर आहे. तो ओंकारच नाहींसा झाला तर शब्द बोलणें व शब्द न बोलणें दोन्ही नाहीसे होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: For thoughtlessness to be the beginning of this silent `word' then, there should be this aum form. But when that aum form is not then, what could that Self utter?

owis.original: अनुभव आणी अनुभविता । सकळ ये मायेचि करितां । ते माया मुळीं नस्तां । त्यासी काये म्हणावें ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनुभव व अनुभव घेणारा दोन्ही मायेमुळें निर्माण होतात. पण जर मायाच नसेल तर अनुभवाला जागाच नाही राहाणार.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the experience, the experiencing and this `all' on account of maya only. But when that Reality is and this maya has never existed then, what should this be called?

owis.original: वस्तु येक आपण येक । ऐसी अस्ती वेगळिक । तरि अनुभवाचा विवेक । बोलों येता सुखें ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मवस्तु निराळी व अनुभव घेणारा मी निराळा असें वेगेळेपण असते तर मी आत्मवस्तुचा अनुभव घेतला असे सुखानें बोलता आले असते.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the One Self and this other called `I'. If such difference still remains then, this is the vivek of the `I am' experience and this `speech' brings the pleasure of duality. (maharaj- your mind will say, `Am I there or am I not there?'; forget that also)

owis.original: वेगळेपणाची माता । ते लटिके वंधेची सुता । म्हणोनियां अभिन्नता । मुळींच आहे ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेगळेपणाची या भावनेची आई माया आहे. मायेमुळे हीचा जन्म झाला. पण वांझ बाईची मुलगी जशी खोटी तशी ही माया खोटी आहे. म्हणून वेगळेपण खोटे आहे. जीव मुलांतच परमात्म्याशी अभिन्न आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to such separateness there is this mother called maya and then that Reality becomes the false daughter of this barren woman (maya is merely imagined and then she imagines more). Therefore, at the root, let there be only unity/non-separation.

owis.original: अजन्मा होता निजेला । तेणें स्वप्नीं स्वप्न देखिला । सद्गुरुस शरण गेला । संसारदुःखें ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला जन्म मरण नाही असा अजन्मा निजलेला होता. त्यानें झोपेंत स्वप्न बघितले. त्यांत तो संसारदुःखाने सद्गुरुस शरण गेला आहे असें बघितलें.
owis.englishMeaning: That which was never born has fallen asleep and on account of this, there was a dream ("I am a body", samsar) seen within this dream `I am'. And then due to the sufferings of samsar, you surrendered to sadguru.

owis.original: सद्गुरुकृपेस्तव । जाला संसार वाव । ज्ञान जालियां ठाव । पुसे अज्ञानाचा ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग सद्गुरुची आपल्यावर कृपा झाली. त्यामुळें संसार खोटा झाला. मग मी आत्माच आहे असें ज्ञान झालें. त्यामुळें मी देह आहे हें अज्ञान नाहींसे झाले.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to sadguru's grace, samsar was made void and then pure knowledge came and wiped out this place of ignorance (`I am' or nothingness).

owis.original: आहे तितुकें नाहीं जालें । नाहीं नाहींपणें निमालें । आहे नाहीं जाऊन उरलें । नसोन कांहीं ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें आहे असें वाटत होते ते नाहींसे झाले. जें नाहीं असें माहीत होते तें कधी नव्हते म्हणून नाहीं असें झाले. अशा रीतीनें आहे व नाहीं हीं दोन्ही नाहींशी झाली.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever is, becomes nothing. And then nothing gets destroyed because it is no- thing. To be and not to be are then both gone and what remains is not this `all'. (maharaj quoted this in marathi so much. First the `many' things disappear from our mind when we stop thinking of them ie. nothing is there. Then this concept of nothingness or knowledge is also dropped in thoughtlessness) 21

owis.original: सुन्यत्वातीत शुद्धज्ञान । तेणें जालें समाधान । ऐक्यरुपें अभिन्न । सहजस्थिती ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आहे व नाहीं यांत गोवलेले सर्व दृश्य विश्व लय पावलें. त्या ज्ञानानें समाधान झालें. आपण व आत्मा एकरुप आहोत या अभिन्नपणाच्या ज्ञानानें सहजस्थिती प्राप्त होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Beyond this nothingness or zero there is that pure knowledge and due to that there is samadhan. Thus, on account of this one sagun form there is that Natural State that is without any division whatsoever. (maharaj if you know it is zero then, you are beyond it or not!)

owis.original: अद्वैतनिरुपण होतां । निमाली द्वैताची वार्ता । ज्ञानचर्चा बोलो जातां ॥ जागृती आली ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें अद्वैताचे विवेचन ऐकले म्हणजे द्वैतानें भरलेले दृश्य खरें नाहीं हे पटते. आत्मज्ञानचे वर्णन ऐकले म्हणजे आपण अज्ञानांत वावरत आहोत ही स्पष्ट जाणीव होते. हीच जागृती होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is that non-dual discourse then the rumour of duality is destroyed. But if this `gossip' of knowledge gets `spoken' then, an awakening has come (ie. first awakening ie. `I am' experience).

owis.original: श्रोता व्हावें सावधान । अर्थीं घालावें मन । खुणे पावता समाधान । अंतरीं कळे ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां श्रोत्यांनी सहजस्थितीचे ऐकलेल्या वर्णनाने मन भरुन टाकावे. असें झालें म्हणजे आत्मज्ञानानें मिळणारें समाधान कसें असतें याची खूण अंतर्यामी बरोबर कळेल.
owis.englishMeaning: In this awakened listener there should be constant alertness and then the mind can be established in the inner *meaning. Due to this there is that pure understanding beyond this `I am' and that is samadhan. *(maharaj the `word' is empty and the meaning is true. The meaning is paramatma)

owis.original: तेणें जितुकें ज्ञान कथिलें । तुतिकें स्वप्नावारीं गेलें । अनुर्वाच्य सुख उरलें । शब्दातीत ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अद्वैताच्या विवेचनामध्यें जेवढें ज्ञान सांगितलें तें शब्दरुप असल्यानें मायेच्या क्षेत्रांतील असते. देहबुद्धीला तें खरे वाटलें तरी स्वरुपानुभवाच्या दृष्टीने तें स्वप्नांतील ज्ञानाप्रमाणेंच आहे. आत्मसाक्षात्कार झाला कीं, तें नाहीसें होते. मग शब्दांच्या पलीकडे असणारे अनिर्वाच्य स्वानंदसुख तेवढें उरते.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to that samadhan, this knowledge that was `spoken' in the dream went away together with the dream and that inexpressible pleasure that is beyond this `word' remained.

owis.original: तेथें शब्देंविण ऐक्यता । अनुभव ना अनुभविता । ऐसा निवांत तो मागुता । जागृती आला ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मज्ञानामध्यें संपूर्ण एकरुपता  असते. अनुभव व अनुभव घेणारा हेदोन तेथें असत नाहीत. ज्ञानच्या या जागृतीमध्यें साधक अत्यंत शांत व स्तब्ध असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: brahman is Oneness without this `word' and brahman is neither the experience nor experiencing. Such is the stillness that comes from the second `awakening' (when one awakes from the original dream to that Reality)

owis.original: तेणें स्वप्नीं स्वप्न देखिला । जागा होऊनि जागृती आला । तेथें शब्द कुंठित जाला । अंत नलगे ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीवानें स्वप्नांत स्वप्न पाहिलें. गुरुच्या उपदेशानें खरें जागेपण आले. आतां शब्दांची शक्ती लटकी पडली. तें अनिर्वाच्य समाधान शब्दांनी सांगणें शक्य नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to that Reality, there is the dream seen within the dream. Having been awake- ned from the dream of samsar, there came this second awakening and `there' in brahman the `word' was choked/confounded and an end could not be reached (ie. that endless, inexpressible paramatma/brahman).

owis.original: या निरुपणाचें मूळ । केलेंचि करुं प्रांजळ । तेणें अंतरी निवळ । समाधान कळे ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां जे विवेचन केलें त्यांतील मुख्य मुद्दे पुन्हा सांगतो. त्यामुळें शुद्ध समाधान कसें असतें तें अंतर्यामी कळून येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: If this sagun discourse is made and clearly `spoken' then, due to this, the inner space of `I am' is purified and samadhan is understood (I do not exist).

owis.original: तव शिष्यें विनविलें । जी हें आतां निरोपिलें । तें पाहिजे बोलिलें । मागुतें स्वामी ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेव्हां शिष्यानें विनविलें कीं, स्वामी आतांपर्यंत जें आपण सांगितलें तें मला पुन्हां सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: At that time the disciple beseeched his Master, "Now, this has all been discoursed but please this should be spoken again swami."

owis.original: मज कराया कारण ।केलेंचि करावें निरुपण । येथील जे कां निजखूण । ते मज अनुभवावी ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा विषय मला नीट कळावा म्हणून सांगितलेलें पुनः सांगावें. त्यांतील आत्मज्ञानाचें जें रहस्य आहें तें माझ्या अनुभवास येईल असें सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: "The means to understand (ie. forget everything and you are there; the sagun dis- course) has been made by me and now that nirgun discourse should be made. Otherwise how can there ever be the understanding of my own Self? That Reality should be un- derstood by this `me'."

owis.original: अजन्मा तो सांग कवण । तेणें देखिला कैसा स्वप्न । तेथें कैसें निरुपण । बोलिलें आहे ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला जन्म मरण या कालाधीन घटना नाहीत. तो अजन्मा कोण? त्याला स्वप्न कसें पडलें? याप्रश्र्णांची उत्तरें कोणती? हें विवेचन पुनः करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: "Who is that one without birth? What is this dream that he is seeing? And how can this `speech' become that pure knowledge of `there'?"

owis.original: जाणोनी शिष्याचा आदर । स्वामी देती प्रत्योत्तर । तेंचि आतां अति तत्पर । श्रोतीं येथें परिसावें ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शिष्याची जिज्ञासा पाहून स्वामींनी परत प्रश्र्णांची उत्तरें दिली. ती श्रोत्यांनी मनःपूर्वक ऐकावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: Knowing the earnestness of the disciple, swami gave the reply. This `speech' within the listener should now be very carefully listened to.

owis.original: ऐक शिष्या सावधान । अजन्मा तो तूंच जाण । तुवां देखिला स्वप्नीं स्वप्न । तोहि आतां सांगतों ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शिष्या, अगदी लक्ष देऊन ऐक. जो अजन्मा म्हणून सांगितला तो खरा तूंच आहेस हें ध्यानांत ठेव. तूं जें स्वप्नांत स्वप्न पाहिलेंस तें देखिल आतां सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: (Forget everything and) Listen carefully dear disciple and you will know that you only are that `unborn'. This dream within the dream is being perceived by you and even now, in this `all', there is that `unborn' paramatma.

owis.original: स्वप्नीं स्वप्नाचा विचार । तो तूं जाण हा संसार । येथें तुवा सारासार । विचार केला ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वप्नामध्यें स्वप्न पाहिलें याचा अर्थ हा संसार होय. " मी आत्मा आहे " हा जागेपणा जाऊन " मी देह आहे " हे स्वप्न होय. माझा संसार आहे हें स्वप्नांतील स्वप्न होय. संसार स्वप्नमय पण त्यांत सार काय असार काय याचा तूं विचार केलास.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless Self had a dream within the dream and then that paramatma became you and that thoughtless understanding became samsar. But then `here' you made a careful investigation and understood the essence, I do not exist.

owis.original: रिघोनि सद्गुरुस शरण । काढून शुद्ध निरुपण । याची करिसी ऊणखूण । प्रत्यक्ष आतां ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नंतर तूं सद्गुरुला शरण गेलास. त्याच्या जवळून शुद्ध आत्मस्वरुपाचे विवेचन ऐकलेस. ही खरी खूण तुला पटली. हा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव आतां तुला आला.
owis.englishMeaning: Going to the feet of sadguru, that pure discourse was extracted and this sensory perception became that hidden nirgun understanding of this `word'.

owis.original: याचाचि घेतां अनुभव । बोलणें तितुकें होतें वाव । निवांत विश्रांतीचा ठाव । ते तूं जाण जागृती ॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यानंतर आत्मस्वरुपाचा अनुभव घेतलास कीं स्वस्वरुपाबद्दलचे शब्दज्ञान आपोाप नाहींसे होईल. अत्यंत निवांत असें विश्रांतीचे स्थान तुला सापडेल. हेंच खरें जागेपण असें समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When the experience of only this `word' is accepted then, there is this `speech'. But this also becomes void and empty and then stillness is your place of rest and you have awakened to that Reality.

owis.original: ज्ञानगोष्टीचा गल्बला । सरोन अर्थ प्रगटला । याचा विचार घेतां आला । अंतरीं अनुभव ॥ ५४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रथम ज्ञान विवेचनाची गडबड थांबेल. ती थांबल्यावर त्याचा अर्थ प्रगट होईल. त्यावर विचार केला कीं लय लागतो. व अंतरीं अनुभव येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the disorder of this `I am' of knowledge ended (ie. when the restless mind full of `many' thoughts stopped) then, this `word' meaning became apparent. And when the thoughtless implied meaning of this `word' was accepted then, again there came another `awakening' (ie. from this original dreamto that Reality).

owis.original: तुज वाटे हे जागृती । मज जाली अनुभवप्राप्ती । या नांव केवळ भ्रांती । फिटली च नाहीं ॥ ५५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तुला वाटेल कीं, जागृति म्हणतात ती हीच. आपल्याला अनुभव प्राप्ती झाली. पण हा केवळ भ्रम असतो. तो गेलेला नसतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But if you feel that, that thoughtless Self has awakened then, it is this experience `I am' that has come to you (ie. you are still there). Then that no-knowledge is this delusion of knowledge and this `I am' has not been removed.

owis.original: अनुभव अनुभवीं विराला । अनुभवेंविण अनुभव आला । हाहि स्वप्नीचा चेईला । नाहींस बापा ॥ ५६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी अनुभव घेतो " ही वृत्ती जाऊन केवळ अनुभवरुपता तेवढी उरली. तरी बाबा, अजून तूं स्वप्नांतून जागा झाला नाहीस.
owis.englishMeaning: When you have dissolved your experiences in this `experience' and this `experience' that is without your experiences has come, still there is not that thoughtless awakening from the dream, my good man! (that One is still caught within subtle concepts. The experiences gained from "I am a body" conviction have dissolved in the experience `I am'. But this should not be mistaken for that thoughtless Reality)

owis.original: जागा जालियां स्वप्नउर्मी । स्वप्नीं म्हणसी अजनमा तो मी । जागेपणें स्वप्नउर्मीं । गेलीच नाहीं ॥ ५७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तूं जागा झालास तरी अजून तुझें स्वप्न नाहींसे झालेले नाही. मीच तो अजन्मा आहे असें तूं स्वप्नांत म्हणतोस. म्हणजेच जागेपणीं स्वप्नाची वृत्ती शिल्लक आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: If you have awoken and arose from the dream and still say, `I am that unborn' then, there is wakefulness (from samsar), but the hidden dream has not gone away.

owis.original: स्वप्नीं वाटे जागेपण । तैसी अनुभवाची खूण । आली परी तें सत्य स्वप्न । भ्रमरुप ॥ ५८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वप्नांत " मी जागा झालों " असें वाटते, त्याचप्रमाणें " मीच तो अजन्मा आहे " या अनुभवाचें लक्षण आहे. तो अनुभव खरा असतो पण अजून भ्रम शिल्लक असतोच.
owis.englishMeaning: When one feels that this wakefulness in the dream is that nirgun understanding of this sagun experience then, still this Truth is a dream and of the nature of delusion (maharaj you take knowledge as true).

owis.original: जागृती या पैलिकडे । तें सांगणें केवि घडे । जेथे धाणाची मोडे । विवेकाची ॥ ५९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संपूर्ण जागेपणा या अनुभवाच्या पलीकडे असतो. शब्दांनीं तो सांगता येणें शक्य नाही. ती सहजस्थिती आहे. तेथे विवेकाचा पाया उखडला जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: The real awakening is beyond this experience but how is it something that can be accomplished (it is as it always is)? Even the holding on to vivek `here' gets broken `there'.

owis.original: म्हणोनि तें समाधान । बोलतांचि न ये ऐसें जाण । निशब्दाची ऐसी खूण । वोळखावी ॥ ६० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून तें समाधान वर्णन करुन सांगता येत नाहीं असें असतें. अनिर्वाच्य म्हणतात त्याचा हा असा अर्थ आहे. हें लक्षांत ठेवावे.
owis.englishMeaning: That Reality is samadhan. Know that even this `speech' does not come `there'. In this way, the understanding of the `word'-less should be recognized.

owis.original: ऐसें आहे समाधान । बोलतांच न ये जाण । इतुकेन बाणली खूण । निशब्दाची ॥ ६१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समाधान हें असें आहे. सांगून सांगता येण्यासारखें तें नाही. समाधान अनिर्वाच्य आहे याचा अर्थ ध्यानांत येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is samadhan and this `speech' cannot be known there. By that much, the nirgun understanding of the `word'-less gets imbibed. .
